answer: Prenatal hair follicles start forming between 11 and 14 post-conception weeks (PCW), initiated by interactions between epidermal placodes and dermal condensates.
support_quote: Prenatal HFs start forming between 11 and 14 post-conception weeks (PCW), initiated by interactions between epidermal placodes (focal sites of epidermal layer thickening) and dermal condensates (aggregates of dermal fibroblasts)
